# x402 Query Cleaner

> Deterministic query-string parsing, tracking-param stripping and canonical rebuild for agents. No accounts. Pay per call with x402 (USDC on Base).

## Paid Endpoint

- POST /api/clean
  - Input: `{ "url": "https://...", "stripTracking": true, "sort": true }`
  - Output: `{ "success": true, "result": {...}, "meta": {...} }`
  - Price: ~0.007 USDC

## Free Discovery

- GET /catalog
- GET / (service card)

## Why agents use it

- Zero variance, pure URL/query transforms
- Removes utm_*, fbclid, gclid, mc_eid etc.
- Perfect for canonicalization, caching keys, privacy hygiene
